followup_reviews.Research finding: Contemporary reports establish intentional trucker obstruction at Cristo Redentor in January 2022, within the observation period; retain inclusion as a protest event distinct from health-control queues. The 20 January report concerns Chile-to-Argentina freight obstruction and the 26 January interview concerns Argentina-to-Chile entry. The record correctly describes differing observed directions without claiming continuous bidirectional closure. P1 retains exact 20 January onset evidence and 26 January last confirmation, no endpoint, held=1 and withheld_continuity. The 29 January protocol and 30 January general queue clearance do not provide a matched final protest endpoint. Numeric duration and both complete flags remain absent/zero. Policy and socioeconomic demands / Opposition to health policies remains supported by truckers’ stated objections to testing arrangements and effects on their work. It is their attributed demand, not the government’s health rationale or proof of every allegation. Both protest accounts were freshly read. The saved ministry and EFE/Emol passages were reread with fingerprints. EFE and its Emol republication are one origin, and official/association statements are not separate eyewitness observations. The single phase remains unlocated at the named road crossing and Argentine approach. No precise barricade coordinate, nationwide outline or continuous animation is justified.
